reporting-org.narrative: Norad - Norwegian Agency for Development Cooperation

description.narrative:
The Project’s expected effect(s) on society (Impact) is conflict-affected populations strengthen their protection and access to rights and livelihoods in an enabling institutional environment that supports peace and sustainability.
The expected effects for the target group of the Project (Outcomes) are: Outcome 1: Communities enhance their self-protection strategies and women’s active leadership in governance structures is strengthened. Outcome 2: Conflict-affected populations in peacebuilding areas strengthen sustainable livelihoods that foster autonomy, resilience, gender equality, and peace. Outcome 3: Communities claim their rights and access public services through legal and advocacy actions that advance gender equality and improve institutional response. Outcome 4: The implementing partner strengthens its technical, operational, and management capacities to independently and sustainably implement project interventions.
The intended target group are diverse, the project will prioritize support for ethnic communities, women and other groups in situations of heightened vulnerability, including social leaders, human rights defenders, peace signatory population and persons with disabilities.
